There was an '''Imperial garrison''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garrthinius]] by the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which enforced the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the planet's population. The garrison base had an unusual modular layout, and included a [[detention area]].

{{RPGseed}}
At some point in the month between the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the founding of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] responded to local revolutionaries' request for assistance in overthrowing the Empire. The garrison was enforcing martial law that had been declared on the planet, and had several revolutionary leaders in custody.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
{{EndGame}}
